answer: Partly. Multiple customer complaints and study scores document unreliable CarPlay, wireless charging, hotspot and voice recognition today (SIG-G60-US-019, SIG-G60-US-029, SIG-G60-US-043, SIG-G60-US-042; EV-G60-US-ST-92 / EV-G60-US-ST-89 / EV-G60-US-ST-98 and many feedback items). The strict numeric targets conflict with the requirement’s stated uncertainties (phone/case diversity; cellular variability) and reports of slow/failing connections, misfit/slow chargers, hotspot slowness and voice misrecognition. Keep the goal but relax or condition targets to reflect external dependencies.
suggested_change: Relax targets and add conditional exceptions: (a) CarPlay/AA: ≥90% within 15s in tested real-world pairings, with OS/version exclusions; (b) wireless pad: ≥90% phone+case combos at ≥7.5W and publish supported sizes/case-thickness; (c) Wi‑Fi: ≥85% of 30‑min sessions in suburban tests with a defined minimum cellular signal level; (d) voice: 85% of 100 common commands with cloud-fallback — revisit as ecosystem stability improves.
